name: 01-happy-small
description: Accounts 1-5 (30 daily transactions, each account has one type-03 credit so the TCATBAL 'Creating' path runs). Accounts 1-2 get a real disclosure group (direct DISCGRP hit); 3-5 keep the blank group (DEFAULT fallback). Account 3's credit limit is lowered so some purchases reject with 102. Account 5 is the last TCATBAL account: CBACT04C never writes its interest back (faithful defect).
